'''Knumai''' was a [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] loyal to the [[Tapani Noble Houses|Tapani Noble House]] [[House Cadriaan|Cadriaan]]. He was one of the rare non-[[Human/Legends|Human]] nobles in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]].<ref name="LOTE" />
